passages.text: Hallelujah! Praise God in His sanctuary. Praise Him in His mighty heavens.
passages.sermon:
God is holy.
God is powerful.
Praise God.
Praise God in His sanctuary.
Praise God in His mighty heavens.
passages.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ הַֽלְלוּ־ אֵ֥ל בְּקָדְשׁ֑וֹ הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בִּרְקִ֥יעַ עֻזּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him for His excellent greatness.
passages.sermon:
God is powerful.
God does great things.
Praise God for His power.
Praise God for His greatness.

passages.text: Praise Him with the sound of the horn; praise Him with the harp and lyre.
passages.sermon:
God is the one we praise.
We praise Him with music.
We use the sound of the horn to praise Him.
We use the harp to praise Him.
We use the lyre to praise Him.
passages.original: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ בְּתֵ֣קַע שׁוֹפָ֑ר הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּנֵ֣בֶל וְכִנּֽוֹר׃

passages.text: Praise Him with tambourine and dancing; praise Him with strings and flute.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God deserves praise.
Use the tambourine to praise God.
Dance to praise God.
Use stringed instruments to praise God.
Use the flute to praise God.
passages.original: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ בְתֹ֣ף וּמָח֑וֹל הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּמִנִּ֥ים וְעוּגָֽב׃

passages.text: Praise Him with clashing cymbals; praise Him with resounding cymbals.
passages.sermon: God deserves praise.\r\nUse clashing cymbals to praise Him.\r\nUse resounding cymbals to praise Him.
passages.original: הַֽלְל֥וּהוּ בְצִלְצְלֵי־ שָׁ֑מַע הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּֽצִלְצְלֵ֥י תְרוּעָֽה׃

passages.text: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Hallelujah!
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
Every living thing has breath.
Every living thing must praise the LORD.
Praise the LORD.
passages.original: כֹּ֣ל הַ֭נְּשָׁמָה תְּהַלֵּ֥ל יָ֗הּ הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
